intent.text: Indep speaks in favour of cost's motion, with one condition I would put in the record. The independence the motion buys comes from the reviewer's model family and from the reviewer not being the author. Both must hold. A single reviewer from a different family satisfies both. A council that is mixed-family but whose members share a family with the author does not, and a council drawn from one family does not count as verification at all. So the motion should say that any escalation council must include at least one family distinct from the author's, and that its agreement is not counted as independent evidence unless that holds. I also agree with plan's point that the review should mark defects in the draft rather than issue a grade; an escalated council should be asked to resolve a named disagreement, not to approve the plan. On the escalation triggers, I would add: any claim the plan states as verified but which the reviewer could not check. Otherwise I have no objection and would support the motion.
